title: Mob Psycho 100
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shigeo 'Mob' Kageyama is a quiet middle schooler with enormous psychic power who suppresses his emotions so they do not explode. He works for Reigen, a self-styled spirit medium and con artist, exorcising ghosts and evil spirits, while trying to improve himself as an ordinary boy and facing psychic organizations and cult-like groups (to verify).
life_message: It holds up kindness, self-improvement and being a good person over having special power.
